review_candidates.title: Network Security Expert
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Summary: We are looking for an experienced Network Security Expert with 7–8 years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, particularly within service provider or system integration environments. Key Responsibilities: Design, implement, configure, and maintain cybersecurity solutions across enterprise environments. Deploy, manage, and troubleshoot security solutions from multiple vendors. Implement and maintain Web Application Firewall (WAF) solutions to protect web applications and services
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Job Summary: We are looking for an experienced Network Security Expert with 7–8 years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, particularly within service provider or system integration environments. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise across network security, firewalls, web application security, network access control, web security, and email security solutions. Required Qualifications: 7–8 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity. Strong hands-on experience with multiple firewall vendors, including: Cisco Palo Alto Fortinet Forcepoint Web Application Firewall (WAF) Strong hands-on experience with: F5 Fortinet Citrix A10 Network Access Control (NAC) Strong hands-on experience with: Cisco Aruba Fortinet Web Security Strong hands-on experience with: Forcepoint Broadcom Email Security Strong hands-on experience with: Forcepoint Cisco Fortinet
